name: Pulse TW-DC1 (Wellcamp) Toowoomba

address.note: Operator contact page: 'Location Pipe Street (Lot 1), Wellcamp, Qld Australia 4350'. FKG: 'Pipe Street, Wellcamp, Queensland'. QLD cadastre (source 7) has two Pipe Street, Wellcamp parcels: Lot 1 SP353522 (2.11 ha) and Lot 3 SP329715 (2.78 ha); which lot holds the DC is not confirmed (the marketing 'Lot 1' may predate the current plan numbering).

lat.note: Taken 2026-09-27 from the map pin (data-lat/data-lng) on Pulse DC's own contact page (-27.5361436, 151.8426896). Cross-check: ArcGIS World Geocoder 'Pipe Street, Wellcamp QLD 4350' returns the street (StreetName match, score 100) at -27.53621, 151.84258 (~12 m away); QLD cadastre Lot 1 SP353522 centroid -27.53747, 151.84100 (~220 m) and Lot 3 SP329715 -27.53762, 151.84378 (~190 m). Approximate to ~200 m.

builder.note: FKG project page: 'Design and Construct Services', 'Completed March 2018', project value '$20M - $50M'.

developer.note: FKG Group described as developer (source 2). Acquired by Centuria in 2026 per master.csv (not re-verified).

mw_it.note: Operator website: 'Tier III Design up to 7.5MW'. Other figures: '2.5MW of IT load for the first building' (FKG, ECD Online Apr 2018 - first stage as opened; DC1 is 720 racks over four equal stages, first 180 racks); '10 megawatt Tier 3 facility' (Urban Developer, Jun 2017 - likely facility power); Computerworld (Apr 2018) 'supply 100 megawatts up from the current 10MW' (site power); RenewMap 7 MW; datacentermap 2.5 MW.

cost_aud_m.note: '$40 million data centre' (Urban Developer, 6 Jun 2017; also Computerworld and ECD Online Apr 2018). FKG lists project value band '$20M - $50M'.

authority.note: presumed Toowoomba Regional Council; approval not found

jobs_operational.note: 5,000 jobs figure refers to whole Toowoomba Technology Park aspiration, not the DC

construction_start.note: Urban Developer 6 June 2017: 'Construction on a massive $40 million data centre in Toowoomba has begun'; completion targeted early 2018.

construction_end.note: FKG: 'Completed March 2018'. Officially opened 19 April 2018 (Computerworld and ECD Online articles dated 19 Apr 2018). Both before the 2018-09-01 cutoff.

open_questions: scope: completion (Mar 2018) is within the 2016-01-01 cutoff; in scope on the operator's 7.5 MW design figure, but the first building is only 2.5 MW IT - confirm design MW
MW: 7.5 MW design (operator) vs 2.5 MW first building vs 10 MW (2017, likely facility power)
lot: Lot 1 SP353522 vs Lot 3 SP329715 on Pipe Street not confirmed
planning approval (Toowoomba Regional Council) not found
